mapper.sql: select c.content_id, c.tongjian_id, c.reign_id, c.volume_id, c.number, c.original, c.simplified, c.translation, c.notes, c.tags, c.source_url, c.create_time, concat_ws('', r.emperor_name, r.reign_name, r.year_anno) as reign_title, v.title as volume_title from tj_content c left join tj_reign r on r.reign_id = c.reign_id left join tj_volume v on v.volume_id = c.volume_id
mapper.select: select content_id, tongjian_id, reign_id, volume_id, number, original, simplified, translation, notes, tags, source_url, create_time from tj_content where reign_id = #{reignId} order by number
select content_id, tongjian_id, reign_id, volume_id, number, original, simplified, translation, notes, tags, source_url, create_time from tj_content where tongjian_id = #{tongjianId}
where c.tags is not null and concat(',', c.tags, ',') like concat('%,', #{tag}, ',%') order by c.volume_id, c.reign_id, c.number
mapper.insert: insert into tj_content (tongjian_id, reign_id, volume_id, number, original, simplified, translation, notes, tags, source_url, create_time) values (#{tongjianId}, #{reignId}, #{volumeId}, #{number}, #{original}, #{simplified}, #{translation}, #{notes}, #{tags}, #{sourceUrl}, now())

insert into tj_content (tongjian_id, reign_id, volume_id, number, original, simplified, translation, notes, tags, source_url, create_time) values
(#{item.tongjianId}, #{item.reignId}, #{item.volumeId}, #{item.number}, #{item.original}, #{item.simplified}, #{item.translation}, #{item.notes}, #{item.tags}, #{item.sourceUrl}, now())
